一组动态影像被投射在多层纱幔之上。光线穿透织物时，影像交叠、流动， 让同一场景持续呈现变幻的观感。

column5: A sequence of moving images is projected onto layers of gauze. As light passes through the fabric, the images overlap and shift, offering changing impressions of the same scene.

column4: 三件装置作品，探讨我们感知世界的不同滤镜。 半透界面、局部遮蔽与镜像反射，改变了熟悉的物象与图像， 促使观者反思自身解读所见之物的方式。
column5: Three installations explore different filters through which we perceive the world. Translucent surfaces, partial concealment and mirrored reflections alter familiar objects and images, inviting viewers to question how they interpret what they see.

column4: 沙丘后方，两面镜子呈直角相接。沙层下方的屏幕循环切换天空与海洋影像。 这些流动的影像仿佛显现在实体沙土之中，而镜像则将这片景观延伸至镜子构筑的虚拟空间里。
column5: Two mirrors meet at a right angle behind a mound of sand. A screen beneath the sand alternates between sky and ocean imagery. These moving images appear within the physical sand, while their reflections extend the landscape into the virtual space of the mirrors.
